active.description:
A card's active status. A card is often activated once the cardholder receives it.

Please refer to the below state machine for allowable transitions:
INACTIVE --> ACTIVE
ACTIVE --> INACTIVE

block.description:
A card's block status. A card may be blocked when lost, stolen, or canceled.

A use case for the BLOCKED NO FRAUD state would be to place the card in this state while there is an investigation into fraudulent activity on the card. 
If the suspected fraud is confirmed, the card may be placed into the BLOCKED WITH FRAUD state. 
Otherwise, the card may be placed back into the OPEN state when the investigation has concluded.

Please refer to the below state machine for allowable transitions:
OPEN --> BLOCKED LOST OR STOLEN
OPEN --> BLOCKED NO FRAUD
OPEN --> BLOCKED WITH FRAUD
BLOCKED NO FRAUD --> OPEN
BLOCKED NO FRAUD --> BLOCKED WITH FRAUD
BLOCKED LOST OR STOLEN --> terminal state
BLOCKED WITH FRAUD --> terminal state

A status change that does not conform to one of the transitions listed above will result in a 400 Bad Request.

lock.description:
A card's lock status. A cardholder may choose to lock a card when it's been misplaced or to temporarily prevent use.

Please refer to the below state machine for allowable transitions:
LOCKED --> UNLOCKED
UNLOCKED --> LOCKED

All periods are rolling if the associated periodLength is greater than 1
